'''Lake Kithas''' is a lake in the central [[Grim Reaches]]. A waterfall sends the water to the [[Grimwater River]], which empties into the [[Forbidding Sea]]. [[Fisherman Nudrew]] sits on the pier on the southern bank of the lake.
